summary: Pass G: adds Weather freshness policy and generated-artifact provenance sidecars to the diagnostics authority, makes wx_forecast.py's six-hour cache boundary authoritative, replaces weather_ingest's delivery sequence with a last-known-good publish_weather_asset command, adds an RBDS wrong-path check (r0048 regression), and wires Weather health into Monitoring via a new weather MonitorCheck kind. No Weather audio/category/filename/cue/schedule change; the three alert paths remain independent.
